<noinclude><pagequality level="3" user="EncycloPetey" />{{rh|220|RETURN OF THE PLOTTING SUITORS.|[ODYSSEY}}</noinclude>{{pline|476|l}}On hearing this Telemachus smiled to his father, but so that Eamæus could not see him.

{{pline|478|l}}Then, when they had finished their work and the meal was ready, they ate it, and every man had his full share so that all were satisfied. As soon as they had had enough to eat and drink, they laid down to rest and enjoyed the boon of sleep.{{pline|481|l}}
